review:
Retro pin-up style on the Bonanza engine. Fruits and scatters pay anywhere and the reels refill after each win.

The multiplier only shows up in free spins, landing with a random value and staying until the refill sequence ends. High volatility, 15,000x max and 96% RTP. Free spins average around once every 395 spins, so it's a waiting game. The theme is what sets it apart from its siblings.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
